Visitor replaces audio element with custom output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_audio(self, ctx, src):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": "[AUDIO: podcast.mp3]"}
    html = '<p>Listen to this: <audio src="podcast.mp3" controls></audio></p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
